title: Publish a guided static replay of Kontor with genuine historical devnet evidence
trigger: User-approved guided GitHub Pages tour; controller-attested source-aware pre-build extension. Independent actors /root/tour_ux, /root/tour_pm and /root/tour_sde submitted assessments and completed UX → PM → SDE → PM exchange. Parent /root alone owns canonical persistence and publication. Schema-valid research artifacts do not constitute a browser-sourced ABU-11/17 receipt.
productRationale: Accept a compact manually navigated actual-workbench tour that teaches 1,000 approved by two people → 200 credit → expired prior approvals → obsolete 1,000 instruction rejected → two fresh approvals → 800 payment → recorded devnet proof. Six chapter groups may contain meaningful substates for both named approvals and the actual payment review. Strong 1,000 → −200 → 800 welcome motif is welcome within scope. Static/reconstructed labeling and dated genuine proof make the experience understandable without requiring wallet, server or network execution.
engineeringDecision: Accept the updated original proposal; SDE feasibility is feasible with no counterproposal. Use a separate static React/Vite entry with an optional explicitly read-only actual App presentation input. Hide mutations and guard all live transport paths. Build pure snapshots from one selected recorded scenario; the guide and payment-review callback only navigate local snapshots. Use isolated publication output and reviewed curated evidence, no source maps or server imports. UX accepts the causal recorded-result guide approach and no unresolved engineering or product objection remains. Canonical task creation and public asset deployment remain parent-controlled under existing user authority.
constraints: Accept the UX acceptance criteria with scope limited to the guided static tour: no backend hosting, wallet connection, new network transaction, program change, video/autoplay, broader integrations or new spending. Keep the existing live app behavior intact.

Use the actual current App workbench through a separate static entry and an explicit read-only snapshot adapter, or an equally isolated source-derived presentation. Tour progression cannot call fetch/RPC, signing, live backend or live reset. SDE must confirm the enforceable implementation boundary.

The primary route traverses separate original Mara/Jonas approvals at 1,000, Lena's 200 credit, expired prior approvals, Alex's blocked obsolete 1,000 instruction, separate fresh Mara/Jonas approvals at 800, payment review and recorded receipt. Back/Next/chapter jumps may inspect coherent snapshots; label them navigation rather than submitting approvals. Restart resets only tour state.

Persist Guided demo / Static replay labeling; explain before interaction that clicks submit no transactions. Identify real explorer links and JSON as recorded Solana devnet evidence from a prior run, with historical dates. Use Test USD / no real value consistently and no Test USD moved for the blocked transaction; do not claim zero fees or no SOL movement.

Use evidence/browser-recovery-export.json scenario c3f46241-966e-4264-ac88-035ed095ca23 as the coherent displayed run. Filter networkProofs by that scenario; do not accidentally include older c863ba5a entries or mix summary/ordering-proof signatures into its chronology. Preserve selected evidence event identities and final mEzYqsk328ch5SeDtwpjN1coekQ8fsoJcvSeReob5mrrZanATzvSRmYRLKQckTWTuyE2agiRbCdkg8m97Ly1pxL settlement.

Parent alone may publish allowlisted static outputs to a separate public kontor-tour repository under the user's accepted publication authority. Keep private source repository private; omit source links that require private access or label them accurately. Never publish .local files, keys, manifests, internal research or source maps accidentally. Public compiled tour code and intended evidence are within scope.

Require complete desktop and 390 px path, keyboard/focus/reduced-motion checks, Back/Restart/chapter state consistency, repository-subpath loading, exact proof links/downloads, no live network calls and shared-app regression checks. Source-aware integration and fresh-context browser-only-by-instruction review are distinct; do not claim enforced isolation or genuine blindness.

Keep no-production-custody, server-held demo-role keys, trusted upgrade authority, unaudited prototype, and program-controlled-payable boundary available with evidence. At most two bounded improvement cycles; parent controls canonical persistence, implementation contracts and any materially broader decision.

Accept SDE reviewed implementation safeguards: absent live mutation controls plus fail-closed guards for refresh/actions/reconcile; initialModal pay with Show recorded payment result callback changes only wrapper state. Keep distinct snapshot substates for both original and fresh approvals. App invoice versions 1/2 and program revisions 0/1 remain distinct. Never backfill final chain balances into earlier reconstructed scenes.

Accept engineering task split with disjoint ownership: SDE src/App.tsx, tour/recorded-state.ts and explicitly delegated build configuration; UX tour/Tour.tsx, tour/tour.css, tour/index.html and tour/main.tsx; parent curated evidence/publication/control plane. Source-aware integration and fresh-context usability review remain separate. Shared-app tests/build and live read-only smoke protect existing behavior.

Historical legacy approval reconciliation provenance remains available in curated evidence if that approval is shown, without adding recovery as a required tour branch. Explain reconstructed historical snapshots and source selection in export metadata; local recorded evidence remains useful if external Explorer is unavailable. Public compiled frontend assets are readable; private repository preservation does not mean frontend code is secret.
rejectedAlternatives: Publish the unmodified live app: it depends on private local backend endpoints and would be broken or misleading on static Pages.
Fake API or signing simulator: hidden transport behavior is unnecessary and makes the execution boundary harder to inspect.
Live-looking approvals/payments that appear submitted by tour clicks: creates an inaccurate network-execution claim. Use explicitly recorded-result navigation and read-only payment review.
Screenshot-only gallery or scaled full-page desktop captures: weak causal interaction and poor phone readability compared with actual responsive App presentation.
Mixing proof signatures from historical scenarios or backfilling final balances: misrepresents the chronology. Use the selected coherent run and omit unknown intermediate values.
Making the private source repository public, copying runtime files or promising inaccessible private-source links: unnecessary for authorized asset-only public tour.
Video/autoplay, hosted backend, new transactions, wallet onboarding or broader integrations: outside this bounded release.
